blockingFindings.title: RunStatus introduces an unfrozen in-progress state
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Remove in-progress from RunStatus and add an explicit acceptance/test expectation that the schema rejects it as an unknown Run state. Retain in-progress only on ActionResult.ExecutionStatus. Recheck the Explore for any other statement that expands the frozen Run state set.

resolvedFindingsFromPriorRevisions.resolution: Action Catalog follows frozen core-model spec's ten formal Actions; change-checkpoint treated as Git boundary.
ResultRef is provider-neutral without mandatory runPath; concrete serialization deferred to C1.
Review focus item 4 updated to require ten Change Actions plus two Delivery Actions.
Section 5.1 object-contract matrix covers all eleven objects with ownership, minimum fields, and validation expectations.
